name: pcb-designer
description: Professional PCB design agent for rapid prototyping on Anna OS. 1.0.7 adds ESP32 support.
author: assalas

linux-x86_64.note: build first: pyinstaller pcb-designer-plugin.spec, then pack dist/pcb-designer-linux-x86_64.tar.gz

credentials.name: OCTOPART_API_KEY
credentials.description: Optional: Octopart API key for live vendor BOM lookups

tools.name: parse_requirements
tools.description: Extract structured component requirements from a natural-language hardware description. Uses deep LLM reasoning (via Anna sampling) with thorough chain-of-thought analysis for MCU selection, voltage domains, and LPKF constraints.

tools.name: generate_bom
tools.description: Generate a Bill of Materials from structured requirements using a built-in part catalog (12 MPNs). Vendor/stock lookups are not implemented; unmatched keywords are returned as *-UNKNOWN and reported in data.warnings.

tools.name: extract_package_from_pdf
tools.description: Deep extraction of package dimensions from a component datasheet PDF. Multi-stage pipeline: text extraction, OCR fallback, LLM-powered dimensional analysis with thorough reasoning for mechanical drawings.

tools.name: generate_footprint
tools.description: Generate a KiCad .kicad_mod footprint file. Supports: qfn, qfp, soic, smd_rc, bga, dip, usbc, header, custom.

tools.name: synthesize_netlist
tools.description: Build a netlist structure from a BOM. CURRENT LIMITATION: nets contain component refs, not REF-PIN pairs, so there is no pad-level connectivity and a router cannot consume it yet.

tools.name: route_pcb
tools.description: Assemble a .kicad_pcb from a netlist with KiCad pcbnew (footprints loaded from <output_dir>/footprints). Returns success:false with reason='backend-unavailable' when KiCad is missing.

tools.name: full_pipeline
tools.description: Run the end-to-end pipeline. data.mode reports reality: 'generated' (KiCad writers ran) or 'template' (shipped ESP32-C3 reference board copied). Template results are flagged template_only=true — never present them as a completed design.
